== Summary ==
Star Trek CCG World Finalists work to complete Missions during the preliminary rounds, Friday. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
